hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; case "$f" in /Users/tow-cfp/.claude/*|/Users/tow-cfp/dotfiles/*) rel=$(git -C /Users/tow-cfp/dotfiles ls-files --others --modified -- . 2>/dev/null | head -1); if [ -z "$rel" ]; then rel=$(basename "$f"); fi; git -C /Users/tow-cfp/dotfiles add -A && git -C /Users/tow-cfp/dotfiles diff --cached --quiet || (git -C /Users/tow-cfp/dotfiles commit -m "update ${rel}" && git -C /Users/tow-cfp/dotfiles push && echo '{"systemMessage":"dotfiles: committed & pushed '"${rel}"'"}') ;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true

statusLine.command: input=$(cat); branch=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); used=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.used_percentage // empty'); out="branch: $branch"; [ -n "$used" ] && out="$out | ctx: $(printf '%.0f' "$used")% used"; echo "$out"
